definitions: A heavy, soft, malleable, bluish-white metallic element, the chemical element of atomic number 82.
A position of advantage in a competition; the first place.
A piece of information or a clue that may help to resolve a problem or mystery.
A leash for guiding an animal.
The principal part in a play or film; the person who plays this part.
examples: Lead is used in car batteries.
They took the lead in the final lap.
The police followed a new lead.
He held the dog on a lead.
She played the lead in the school play.
